docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
📥 immunread — Read immune repertoire data in R

API reference · Issues · ImmunoMind ecosystem

immunread imports AIRR, 10x Genomics, BD Rhapsody, MiXCR, Immcantation, Dandelion, Parse Biosciences, TRUST4, WAT3R, and Adaptive immunoSEQ data into immundata::ImmunData objects. Readers use duckplyr for large datasets and accept manifests through immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Install the development packages from GitHub:

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak(c("immunomind/immundata@dev", "immunomind/immunread"))

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
library(immunread)

path <- system.file(
  "extdata", "airr", "2.0-bulk", "contigs.tsv.gz",
  package = "immunread"
)
idata <- read_airr_bulk(
  path,
  schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-")
)

The package is under development; its API may change before version 1.0.

docs.title: Description
docs.text:
Reads 10x Genomics V(D)J contig annotations and maps their barcode, locus, gene, sequence, and count fields to AIRR-style columns.

Supplied secondary chains are retained; immundata ranks chains when constructing receptors. umis and reads remain distinct counts.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_10x(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "10x", "9.0.1", "contigs.csv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
idata <- read_10x(path, schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))

docs.title: Read Adaptive immunoSEQ Analyzer and Connector tables
Description
docs.text:
Reads Adaptive immunoSEQ Analyzer or Connector tables and maps their resolved gene, CDR3, sequence, and abundance fields to AIRR-style columns.

Resolved gene calls are used directly. templates supplies bulk abundance for Analyzer and Connector; Analyzer v2 uses count (templates/reads). seq_reads remains a distinct source count when present.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_adaptive(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "adaptive", "analyzer", "contigs.tsv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
idata <- read_adaptive(path, schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))

Description

  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,

docs.title: Read an AIRR Rearrangement table as single-cell repertoire data
Description
docs.text:
Reads a single-cell AIRR Rearrangement table, maps barcode to cell_id when needed, and selects chains using their count field.

Uses barcode as cell_id when cell_id is absent.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_airr_sc(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Value
docs.text: An ImmunData object.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "airr", "2.0-sc", "contigs.tsv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
schema <- immundata::make_receptor_schema(
  c("v_call", "junction_aa"), chains = "TRB")
idata <- read_airr_sc(path, schema = schema,
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))

docs.title: Description

Reads BD Rhapsody AIRR-like contigs and preserves their cell, locus, receptor, and count fields in an ImmunData object.

Supplied secondary chains are retained; immundata ranks chains when constructing receptors. BD count fields keep their source meanings.

read_bd(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "bd", "2.3", "contigs.csv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)

docs.title: Description
docs.text:
Reads Immcantation AIRR-like tables in bulk or single-cell mode and maps their receptor and abundance fields to AIRR-style columns.

Supplied secondary chains are retained in single-cell mode; immundata ranks chains when constructing receptors.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_immcantation(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  mode = c("sc", "bulk"),
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). mode “sc” for single-cell tables or “bulk” for bulk tables. … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "immcantation", "4.6.0", "contigs.csv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
idata <- read_immcantation(path, schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  mode = "sc", output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))

docs.title: Description
docs.text:
Reads wide Parse Biosciences TCR tables, emits one row per supplied chain, and maps the result to AIRR-style columns.

Each supplied primary or secondary TRA/TRB chain becomes a row. immundata ranks chains when constructing receptors. Transcript counts are used for ranking; source read counts remain separate.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_parsebio(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "parsebio", "1.6.1", "contigs.csv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
idata <- read_parsebio(path, schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))

docs.title: Description
docs.text:
Reads TRUST4 cell tables, expands embedded chain records, and maps their receptor and count fields to AIRR-style columns.

Each supplied primary or secondary chain becomes a row. immundata ranks chains when constructing receptors. The embedded read_cnt becomes consensus_count, following TRUST4’s AIRR export.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
read_trust4(
  path,
  schema,
  manifest = NULL,
  manifest_file_col = "file",
  column_profile = "standard",
  repertoire_schema = "<auto>",
  ...
)

docs.title: Arguments
docs.text: path Repertoire file paths, glob, or “\”. schema Receptor features or an immundata::make_receptor_schema() result. manifest Optional native immundata manifest. manifest_file_col Manifest column containing file paths when path = “\”. column_profile Source columns to keep: “minimal”, “standard”, or “full”. repertoire_schema Repertoire grouping passed to immundata::read_repertoires(). … Other arguments passed to immundata::read_repertoires().

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
library("immunread")

path <- system.file("extdata", "trust4", "1.1.7", "contigs.csv.gz",
  package = "immunread", mustWork = TRUE)
idata <- read_trust4(path, schema = c("v_call", "junction_aa"),
  output_folder = tempfile("immunread-"))
